lines.1: 「I swore I'd make you happy, and I mean it. I'll make you happy no matter what!」
lines.3: 「W-what is this...? I... I don't know what I'm supposed to do.」
lines.6: 「C-cry...? Oh... So this is when you cry.」
lines.8: 「But... when I cry, it's annoying, and tears and snot make my face ugly... I was told to stop...」
lines.9: 「When you want to cry, you're allowed to cry.」
lines.10: 「Otherwise why would people be able to do it at all?」
lines.11: 「They said it was shameful if anyone saw me...」
lines.12: 「There's nobody here but you and me.」
lines.13: 「And in this downpour, nobody could hear you anyway.」
lines.15: 「...Yoshimi. If you say I've given you a whole world, then show me all the faces you have.」
lines.16: 「I won't hate you. Let it out as loudly as you need.」
lines.17: 「...You won't make fun of me if I cry?」
lines.21: She was trusting me and trying to let her feelings out.
lines.23: 「It's okay. Don't force yourself to talk or you'll bite your tongue.」
lines.26: Everything she'd dammed up came pouring out at once.
lines.28: She was crying now for every time she'd wanted to cry and couldn't.
lines.29: 「It's weird... When I'm really crying, not pretending... hic... I can't stop...」
lines.33: But I felt as though something inside her had finally broken free.
lines.35: She kept sobbing with her whole body, no longer caring how she looked.
lines.37: 「L-Leo... Thank you... hic... sob... Thank you...」
lines.38: Like a newborn child crying after coming into the world.
